pages.text: Near the end of the Bible, Jesus says, "Look! I am standing at the door, knocking. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and share a meal with you."
Jesus is always ready to be close to us. We open the door of our hearts when we pray, listen and say yes to Him.
When we open the door, Jesus comes in and is our friend. At Mass, we share a meal with Him, and He gives us Himself.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus is knocking at the door of our hearts. We can open it with prayer and by going to Mass.

pages.text: At the very end of the Bible, John saw a new heaven and a new earth, shining and beautiful. God lives there with His people.
A voice said, "God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, no more sadness, and no more pain."
God said, "Look, I make all things new!" One day, everyone who loves God will be with Him forever in heaven. God loves you and wants to be with you.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: God promises a happy place with no more tears. He wants all of us to be with Him forever.
